name: Gladias
enRole: A citizen. A father. A keeper of questions.
zhRole: 公民、父亲，也是不断追问的人。
enBio: A member of Veridia's Order of Steering, Gladias moves between public duties and family life. His questions about his country's institutions grow harder to set aside.
zhBio: 维里迪亚掌舵会成员。在公共职责与家庭生活之间，格拉迪亚斯逐渐发现，对制度的疑问无法永远搁置。

name: Zei Leimin
enRole: A player learning a much larger game.
zhRole: 擅长游戏，也开始面对更大的博弈。
enBio: A Minpentai player in Dzego with an interest in physics and cryptography. Zei's talent for understanding rules takes on consequences far beyond a game board.
zhBio: 泽戈的敏彭泰选手，对物理与密码学充满兴趣。他理解规则的能力，逐渐需要在棋盘之外承担责任。

name: Bai Jahen
enRole: A rival. An ally. A connection that matters.
zhRole: 从对手到伙伴，人与人的联系至关重要。
enBio: A fellow Minpentai player whose relationship with Zei develops through competition, difficult conversations and cooperation. Bai brings her own experience of trust and belonging.
zhBio: 同样是一名敏彭泰选手。竞争、坦诚与合作，让拜与泽伊的关系不断发展；她也有自己对于信任和归属的理解。

name: Seila
enRole: An observer of the world. An anchor at home.
zhRole: 观察远方，也守护身边的人。
enBio: A writer on economics and culture, a traveler and a co-parent with Gladias. Seila's perspective connects unfamiliar societies to the intimate realities of a family.
zhBio: 经济与文化博主、旅行观察者，也是与格拉迪亚斯共同养育孩子的家人。她的视角连接不同社会与切身的家庭生活。

name: Fin
enRole: Curiosity, language and a practical mind.
zhRole: 好奇心、语言与解决问题的头脑。
enBio: Zei's friend, interested in language and technical problems. Fin's training and experiments run alongside the group's changing challenges.
zhBio: 泽伊的朋友，热衷于语言与技术问题。面对不断变化的挑战，芬持续学习、实验，并尝试找到可用的办法。

name: Mu
enRole: Clear eyes in an uncertain future.
zhRole: 在不确定的未来面前，保持清醒。
enBio: An important collaborator in the later chapters. Mu works alongside Zei as the story moves toward the snowy forests of Veridia.
zhBio: 故事后半程的重要合作者。当行动推进至维里迪亚覆雪的森林，穆与泽伊并肩面对不确定的局势。
